text.inkscape:label: Basic Actions and reactions
text.tspan: You have 4 Action Points (AP) each turn.

tspan.tspan:
Reactions can be used at any time during the game, but some have spesific restrictions. Most reactions have Exhaust which means to suffer the Exhausted status effect and can only be used if not Exhausted
Cower: Exhaust Reduce incoming damage by 1
Reposition: Exhaust At the start of another beings turn, move one hex.
